title: Future middle
subtitle: Read future forms with middle endings.
overview: Future middle uses a future stem with primary middle endings. Some common verbs are naturally middle in form.
Read the lexical meaning first; do not add “for oneself” automatically.

sections.title: λύσομαι: future middle
rows: I will loose myself / arrange for release

items.en: I will go to the Father.
He or she will receive the word.
